{{Top|leg}}
A '''Braftosorn''' was a type of creature. They stood about three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high and had large [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Trantos]] encountered a Braftosorn while they were on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pzandias/Legends|Pzandias]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The creature attacked them and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Alpha 58.
